title: Missing Man, Part 2
description: Missing Man, Part 2 — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Sir Ving N'Seacressy

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Escape the underlife and steal the secret plans from the gated R&D room in the Guild of Shadows Training Chamber of Doom. Afterward, meet with Sir Ving N'Seacressy in the Shadow's Gate.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Sir Ving N'Seacressy

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Missing Man, Part 3

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Escape the underlife and steal the secret plans from the gated R&D room in the Guild of Shadows Training Chamber of Doom. Afterward, meet with Sir Ving N'Seacressy in the Shadow's Gate.

Offer:

I'm confused. I was looking for a way into a secret Resurrection & Development lab in the Guild of Shadows Training Chamber of Doom when I got jumped and killed by Guild of Shadows operatives. I thought, No biggie, I'll just resurrect in the graveyard and get back to where I left off. Except I never resurrected!

This has never happened to me before. I mean, you're *always* supposed to resurrect, right? I guess one of these gates must lead to the way out of this...this spiritual plane, but, well, I heard scary noises coming from the other rooms.

Do me a favor, would you? I need you to finish my mission: After you unlock one of these gates and escape, search through the R&D lab and steal their secret plans. Bring those plans back to Sir Ving N'Seacressy and tell him that Johann's Whisker Has a large moustache. He'll know what to do.

Turn-in:

I was almost beginning to think you weren't coming back.

Objectives:

  • Secret Plans: Kirby's Blanket ×1

Level range: 45–100
